verdict.rationale: Firebase ships an official CLI (firebase-tools) that deploys code and assets, serves Hosting locally, works with database data, and imports/exports Auth users. Functions deploy with one command from the command line, and the Local Emulator Suite plus Test SDK support integration and unit testing without touching production. These are the core building blocks of headless, scripted automation. missing for 10: explicit documentation of CI usage (non-interactive auth such as service accounts or tokens, CI pipeline examples), independent or hands-on corroboration of running in CI.
